about_the_game:
Master your cards, upgrade your gear, and watch chaos unfold in this dark fantasy RPG set in a world corrupted by darkness

A WORLD GONE DARK

Once a year, a lone warrior must carry the Lantern of Eternal Flame across a decaying world to reignite the lighthouse and keep hope alive

Fight through twisted lands, recruit allies, and reshape your build as corruption creeps in. No warrior has ever returned-yet the light always burns. And as long as you hold the Lantern, death is never the end

BUILD YOUR POWER

Choose cards. Equip powerful items & relics. Shape your hero run by run. Every decision shifts your build and your odds of survival

FEATURES:

  • Juicy, chaotic combat – Deckbuilding meets explosive RPG auto-battles. Enemies burn, freeze, shatter, and melt as you and your summons tear through corrupted monstrosities

  • Deep custom character builds – Become a lone tank, a swarm-summoning shaman, or something in between. Build around cards, gear, and passives

  • 300+ hand drawn items – Every item is unique and visually appears on your character in combat

  • A massive world map – Choose your path through story nodes, conquer quests, face grotesque bosses, and push toward the Lighthouse

DISCORD

Join our Discord, so you can play earlier versions and give us feedback and suggestions! The link's on the right sidebar

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-750 (quad-core) / AMD® Phenom™ II X4 965 (quad-core)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GT 630 (2 GB) / AMD® Radeon™ HD 6670 (2 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2300 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows® 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-3570 (quad-core) / AMD® FX-Series™ FX-8300 (quad-core)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 650 (2 GB) / AMD® Radeon™ HD 7750 (2 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2300 MB available space

short_description: CARNEDGE is a dark fantasy RPG where you drag the Eternal Flame across a dying world. Build deadly decks, summon weird allies, and fight through twisted dungeons full of enemies that hate your guts and watch chaos unfold!
